node.statement: Let u_grp denote the function called u_delta by lem-stage1-approximate-group-laws. By 1.7.2-1.7.3 that external applies, so mu_grp(U,V)=u_grp(U bold-dot V) and sigma_grp(U)=u_grp(U^dagger) are C^1 and satisfy its three exact identities and five estimates with bound A*epsilon_r.
